claims.text: Google acquired the cloud-security firm Wiz to close a security gap with competitors AWS and Azure, betting that cloud-security consolidation would be the next battleground in the "cloud wars" driven by AI-driven cloud adoption [Source: ev-1].
The deal signaled this strategic shift toward securing the market as it consolidated around these new drivers.

claims.text: The acquisition was announced on March 18, 2025, for approximately $32 billion in an all-cash transaction, making it the largest acquisition in Google's history [Source: ev-1].
This final price followed Wiz’s rejection of an earlier offer from Google worth $23 billion in July 2024 [Source: ev-1].
Although the agreement was reached in March 2025 and involved shareholder and regulatory steps, the deal officially closed later that same year, with completion reported in July 2025 [Source: ev-1].
